title: Millbrook Matters

headings.text: New play area opens on the Green

key_sentences: After two years of fundraising and three months of building work, the new play area on Millbrook Green opened on Saturday 10 October.
The project cost 48,000 pounds, of which more than a third was raised by residents themselves.
The housing association has confirmed that the boilers in Ash and Beech Houses will be replaced before the end of January.
The committee meets on the first Tuesday of every month in the community room.
Five residents were elected to the committee at the annual meeting in September.
All events are free, and everyone living on the estate is welcome.
Glass now goes in the green bins only.

list_items.text: 24 Dec Estate office closes at noon
